# NEXT3 Media

> NEXT3 Media is a media and communications agency based in Bengaluru (Karnataka) and Hyderabad (Telangana), India. Tagline: "Innovate. Automate. Elevate." Contact: info@next3media.com

NEXT3 Media plans, produces and promotes brand stories end-to-end with one integrated team of PR strategists, event specialists, filmmakers, photographers and digital marketers. Clients can hire a single service or the full package.

## Services
- Public Relations & Corporate PR: reputation building, press releases, media relations and crisis communication.
- Corporate Events & Conferences: product launches, summits, conferences, award nights and corporate gatherings.
- Wedding & Special Events: weddings, receptions and milestone celebrations.
- Photography & Videography: candid, commercial, product and event photo and video coverage.
- Digital Marketing & Social Media: strategy, content, ads and community management.
- Influencer Marketing: creator selection, collaborations and campaign tracking.
- Brand Promotions & Activations: on-ground activations, mall promotions, roadshows and experiential campaigns.
- Film & Advertising Production: TV commercials, corporate films, ad films and branded content.
- Media Coverage & Communications: print, TV and online coverage and communication strategy.

## Locations
- Bengaluru, Karnataka, India — corporate events, startup PR, brand activations, influencer campaigns.
- Hyderabad, Telangana, India — weddings, film & ad production, media coverage, corporate events.
- Projects in other cities on request.

## How to engage
- Email info@next3media.com with the event, brand or campaign details; the team replies within 24 hours.
- Pricing is quoted per project based on scope, scale, location and deliverables.
